title: npm repository settings
description: The npm member of a repository document (R-REPO-004). A member lists the classes it applies to in x-trove-classes; a member of another class is refused as not applicable.

latestGuard.description: A publish under latest does not move latest backwards or onto a pre-release in front of a release; the version is stored and latest stays (R-NPM-016).

serveRemovedVersions.description: Serve the cached tarball of a version the upstream no longer lists, and keep its package served when the upstream drops it (R-NPM-026). The package documents never list such a version.

latestStrategy.description: How a virtual repository merges latest (R-NPM-031).

distTagStrategy.description: How a virtual repository merges the other dist-tags (R-NPM-031).

audit.description: The security audit endpoint (R-NPM-038): forward the names this remote has fetched, and that nothing marks internal, to an advisory provider.

mode.description: forward answers audits through this remote; disabled answers 501 npm_audit_unavailable.

providerURL.description: The https registry URL of the advisory provider, without user info, query or fragment; null is the remote's upstream URL. The provider gets the repository's sealed upstream credentials only when it is the upstream's origin or an extraHosts entry with sendCredentials (R-REPO-033), never through the URL.

timeout.description: The longest a forward may take, 1s to 300s; never longer than server.shutdown_timeout minus one second.

maxBodySize.description: The largest audit body as sent, 1KiB to 10MiB; ten times that decompressed. Larger bodies answer 413.
